title: 从建筑照片到可组装的纸灯
title_en: From architecture photos to a paper lamp
summary: OpenAI 团队以芝加哥 Marina City 的阳台为灵感，用 Astra 迭代 CAD 设计并生成纸灯定制网站，最后手工组装实物。
summary_en: OpenAI used Astra to iterate a CAD design inspired by Marina City and generate a lamp-builder website. The team assembled the physical lamp by hand.
